record_type_quote: This study undertakes a replication and extension of the work by Gohou and Soumaré (GS hereafter; World Development, 2012). Using a sample of 52 African countries from 1990 to 2007, GS found a positive relationship between foreign direct investment (FDI) and poverty reduction, moderated by regional integration. This paper reassesses the robustness of GS's findings by (1) reproducing their study and (2) conducting a replication and extension with updated data (1990–2022), measures of poverty and FDI, and moderators including institutional quality and the sectoral composition of investment.

targets.outcome_quote: Our analysis fails to corroborate the results. We uncover no consistent evidence to support the hypothesis that FDI reduces poverty, and the regional patterns differ from those originally reported.
